.. change::
    :tags: feature, engine
    :tickets: 13700

    Added :class:`.ReflectionCache`, a shareable, versioned cache for
    :class:`_reflection.Inspector` results. The cache can be passed to
    :func:`_sa.inspect` via the new ``reflection_cache`` keyword argument so
    that multiple inspectors reuse the same reflected data. The new
    :meth:`_reflection.Inspector.invalidate_cache` method (also available as
    :meth:`.ReflectionCache.invalidate`) selectively invalidates cached
    entries by table and :class:`.ReflectionCategory`, covering both the
    single-table and multi-table (batch) reflection methods, while leaving
    unrelated entries cached; :meth:`.ReflectionCache.bump_version` and the
    new :class:`.CacheVersion` allow schema changes (including across a
    reconnect) to invalidate older entries in every sharing inspector. All
    cache operations are synchronized so that readers observe either the
    previous or the current entry, never a partially invalidated state.
    Inspectors that do not use a :class:`.ReflectionCache` retain their
    previous private-dict caching behavior, including
    :meth:`_reflection.Inspector.clear_cache`.
